intro: Education and homelab environments bore the brunt of Linux-focused activity between April and July 2026, with manufacturing, IoT, and maker sectors also affected. Eight articles covered a mix of five high-severity incidents, one medium, and two informational pieces, touching regions from the Russian federation to South Asia. Threat actors Harvester, Payouts King, and The Gentlemen were observed in these campaigns. Technical attention centered on CVE-2026-31431, rated CVSS 7.8, as a key vulnerability. The reporting spans a global footprint, underscoring the broad reach of these Linux-targeting operations across both enterprise and enthusiast networks.
